name: How long does plan check take for a second-story addition in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical plan check timeline for a second-story addition in Los Angeles or nearby cities, and what usually causes delays?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical plan check timeline for a second-story addition in Los Angeles or nearby cities, and what usually causes delays?

acceptedAnswer.text: The plan check timeline for a second-story addition depends on the city, the completeness of the drawings, and whether the property triggers special review. In straightforward cases, homeowners may get through initial review in a matter of weeks, but many projects take longer once corrections are issued and resubmittals are needed. Delays often happen when the plans are missing engineering details, do not clearly show existing versus proposed conditions, or conflict with zoning, height, setback, or design-review rules. Properties in Pasadena, Los Angeles, or other nearby jurisdictions can face additional review if they are in a historic district, hillside area, or neighborhood with overlay requirements. The fastest approvals usually come from a well-prepared submittal package with coordinated architectural, structural, and MEP plans. Homeowners should also plan for time after plan check because permit issuance, contractor coordination, and utility scheduling can add more weeks before construction starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan check for a second-story addition can take several weeks to a few months, depending on the city, submittal quality, and whether the property needs extra review. Delays often come from incomplete drawings, structural corrections, zoning issues, special overlays, or revisions requested by the plan examiner.
